snippet.description:
[Review Number 483] I play some Gravebound (early access) and give my opinion throughout... skip to the end if you just want the review summary. How does the game compare to similar 3rd person looter shooter games like The Division 2, Outriders or Helldivers 2? Is it worth buying or playing $15?

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP or https://streamelements.com/lfpgaming/tip and you can also buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613050/Gravebound/

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM

0:10 Opening Issues
x Gameplay
x Verdict

Steam description: "Gravebound is a 6-player co-op extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by rogue machines. Scavenge valuable loot, survive intense firefights, complete dynamic objectives, and extract alive to keep what you earn. Push deeper for rarer rewards, tougher enemies, and higher stakes."
